record_title: Compact recurrent words upgrade weak projection products to strong convergence
provenance: Scientific sources and verification evidence are listed in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
limitations: The criterion is sufficient, not necessary. Multi-letter gates require consecutive recurrence of the ordered word. No rate or operator-norm convergence is claimed, and no extension to arbitrary oblique or nonlinear projections is asserted. Older finite-family compactness and angle criteria remain a residual originality risk; originality is to the best of our knowledge.
